Enter your email and we'll notify you when it's available again. I have read and accept the Privacy Policy Forged in Doom. Born to Roar. The Cult Overdrive is the hell-forged evolution of the legendary Zendrive Overdrive—reborn for players who crave monolithic tone, seismic weight, and crystal clarity in the lowest tunings imaginable. Designed to crush without compromise, it channels a massive, earth-rending voice that stays tight and articulate where others drown in mud or fizz. Voiced to tame harsh feedback and avoid the sterile sizzle of lesser drives, the Cult delivers a cataclysmic overdrive that hits like a tectonic shift. Lows remain tight and pushing, mids slice through any mix with surgical precision, and highs breathe with warmth and vitality—turning every riff into a wall of sound that you feel in your bones. Its touch-sensitive response makes it feel less like a pedal and more like a living, breathing extension of your instrument. Roll back your guitar’s volume for grimy, vintage textures—or dig in and unleash a roaring tide of saturated doom, all without touching a single knob. Every nuance, every pick attack, every dive into dissonance is captured in vivid, aggressive detail—rich, articulate, and unapologetically expressive. The Cult isn’t just a stompbox—it’s an altar of tone. Commanding, musical, and brutally effective, it thrives in high-gain chaos while keeping your sound tight, clear, and alive. Where other drives fall apart, the Cult stands unshaken. Encased in a chemically etched, black patina-treated enclosure and finished with smooth oiling, each unit bears its own distinct character—a relic forged by hand, not stamped by machine. Plug in.
